login.title: Ukungena Kozakwethu Wesiteshi
login.welcome: Siyakwamukela! Ngena ngemvume ukuze uphathe ukuhola kwakho.
login.heroTitle: Khulisa ibhizinisi lakho lezindlu ezithengiswayo ngawo wonke umkhondo owulethayo
login.heroIntro: Ingosi eyodwa yokubhalisa amakhasimende kubakhi, gcina ikhredithi yomkhondo wakho futhi uwalandele kuze kube yilapho ubhukha.

register.title: Bhalisa abaholayo ngemizuzwana
register.text: Thumela ikhasimende lakho kanye nephrojekthi elinentshisekelo kuyo.

protect.title: Ukuvikela okuyimpinda
protect.text: Ukuhola kwakho kuhlala kungokwakho ngesikhathi sokuvikela, ngakho akekho omunye ongafuna ikhasimende elifanayo.

track.title: Landelela zonke izigaba
track.text: Bona isimo somholi ngamunye nomlando ogcwele, kusukela koxhumana naye wokuqala kuya ekubhukheni.

handover.title: Ikhredithi ekubhukheni
handover.text: Uma ikhasimende libhukha, ukuhola kudluliselwa kumakhi nawe urekhodwe njengozakwethu womthombo.

login.secure: Vikela ukungena ngemvume - imininingwane yamakhasimende akho ihlala iyimfihlo

signup.title: Ukubhaliswa Kozakwethu Wesiteshi
signup.intro: Dala i-akhawunti yakho ukuze uqale ukubhalisa nokuphatha imikhondo yakho.
